newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT- Bufete cut to mkt perform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Bufete cut to mkt perform.

text.p: Sandander Investment said on Wednesday it downgraded its recommendation on Mexican builder Bufete Industrial to market perform from buy.
"Bufete has become more expensive and the expected rebound in earnings in 1998 has been largely anticipated," analysts Guillermo Serrano and Luis Laboy wrote.
The analysts said the company is positioned to win new public sector contracts in the energy sector for the second half.
They said the stock price rose with Bufete's announced bids for projects for state oil and gas monopoly Petrleos Mexicanos (Pemex).

"Bufete's current backlog is approximately $390 million. We estimate that the backlog could rise to around $900 (million) by year-end 1997 if it wins the Cadereyta refinery or the Pemex nitrogen plant, in addition to one electricity plant (Rosarito, Monterrey or Chihuahua)," they wrote.
Bufete's shares in Mexico stood at 57.30 pesos at midday, down 40 centavos from Tuesday's close.
